title: Company profile
lead: Candidates decide whether to accept an invitation partly by who sent it. You need a profile to publish vacancies and send invitations.
missing: The profile is not filled in yet: without it you cannot publish a vacancy or send an invitation.

sections.aboutLead: Name, industry and a couple of paragraphs about what you do.
sections.contactsLead: Where candidates can write with general questions. The contact for a specific invitation goes into the invitation itself.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionHint: Product, team size, technologies. Candidates see the text as is.

state.new: The profile is not saved yet

toast.created: Company profile created, you can publish vacancies now

preview.title: How candidates see you
preview.lead: This is how the company looks in an invitation and a vacancy. It updates as you type.
preview.noDescription: The company description will appear here.
preview.note: A candidate's contacts open to you only after they accept an invitation or apply themselves.

domain.title: Trust mark
domain.lead: Confirm that an address on the company website domain is yours. Candidates will see the “domain confirmed” mark in invitations and vacancies. Everything works without it.
domain.emailHint: For example, hr@your-domain.com. The link will be sent there
domain.sent: The email went to {{email}}. Open the link in it
domain.noWebsite: Add the company website and save the profile: the address on its domain is confirmed
domain.noToken: The link has no confirmation token
